mc.client.Screen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.Screen
mc.client.Screen.note: render(DrawContext, int, int, float) 签名不变；1.21.6 起 GUI 改为「先收集后渲染」：drawTexture/drawGuiTexture 首参改为 RenderPipeline（RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED，net.minecraft.client.gl），像素 UV 参数不变；getMatrices() 返回 org.joml.Matrix3x2fStack（pushMatrix/popMatrix/translate(x, y)，没有 z）；drawText 等不再返回宽度；refreshWidgetPositions 用于重新布局

mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.name: net.minecraft.client.gui.screen.ingame.HandledScreen
mc.client.AbstractContainerScreen.note: Yarn 名为 HandledScreen<T extends ScreenHandler>；1.21.6 起 drawBackground 中的 drawTexture 首参改为 RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED，矩阵栈为二维 Matrix3x2fStack；绑定用 HandledScreens.register(type, 构造)

mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.name: net.minecraft.block.entity.BlockEntity
mc.blockentity.BlockEntity.note: 构造需要 (BlockEntityType, BlockPos, BlockState)；1.21.6 起存档读写改为 readData(ReadView)/writeData(WriteView)（net.minecraft.storage），不再直接接触 NbtCompound 与 WrapperLookup；同步用的 toInitialChunkDataNbt(RegistryWrapper.WrapperLookup) 仍返回 NbtCompound

mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.name: net.minecraft.server.network.ServerPlayerEntity
mc.entity.player.ServerPlayer.note: Yarn 名为 ServerPlayerEntity（Mojmap ServerPlayer）；1.21.6 起 server 字段改为 private，取服务器用 player.getServerWorld().getServer()；getServerWorld() 仍返回 ServerWorld

mc.item.ItemStack.name: net.minecraft.item.ItemStack
mc.item.ItemStack.note: 数据全部由组件承载（get/set/remove/contains/getOrDefault/apply）；1.21.6 起 toNbt/fromNbt 删除，存档中读写物品改用 Codec：view.put("Item", ItemStack.CODEC, stack)、view.read("Item", ItemStack.CODEC)（ReadView/WriteView）

fabric.client.BlockRenderLayerMap.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.rendering.v1.BlockRenderLayerMap
fabric.client.BlockRenderLayerMap.note: 1.21.6 起并入 fabric-rendering-v1 并改为静态方法：BlockRenderLayerMap.putBlock(BLOCK, BlockRenderLayer.CUTOUT)（不再有 INSTANCE），层类型改为 BlockRenderLayer 枚举而非 RenderLayer

fabric.event.HudRenderCallback.name: net.fabricmc.fabric.api.client.rendering.v1.HudRenderCallback
fabric.event.HudRenderCallback.note: 1.21.6 起废弃，HUD 由 HudElementRegistry 管理：HudElementRegistry.addLast(Identifier.of(MODID, "x"), (drawContext, tickCounter) -> ...)，或 attachElementBefore/attachElementAfter 挂在原版元素前后；HudLayerRegistrationCallback 已删除
